name: Routing — APIM fronting Azure OpenAI
summary: Baseline: ApiManagement connection where the upstream is an Azure OpenAI deployment.
description: An `ApiManagement` AI Gateway connection fronting OpenAI-compatible deployments is the standard BYOM route for `model='{connection}/{deployment}'`. It gives agents and Responses API calls APIM load balancing, policy, private networking, and observability while preserving the Foundry project endpoint.
notes:
Verified through the concrete Prompt Agent and Responses API probes rather than a separate rollup test. See `prompt-agents-static`, `responses-direct`, and `tool-*` cards for APIM OpenAI routing evidence.

This is the dependency shape most agents and tools in the matrix use.
